author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Accolades Trailer for Marathon, the hit sci-fi extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players will descend onto the harsh lands of Tau Ceti 4 to scavenge supplies, extract with gear, and take out Runners for their loot or for sport. Take a look at the latest trailer to garner the critical reception behind Marathon, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marathon - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Expedition Idle announcement trailer for this upcoming online idle auto-battler ARPG where you create one-of-a-kind items with crafting materials you pick up from the ground, customize your adventurers with different abilities and stats, and strategize your way through difficult bosses, unique scenarios, and dynamic monsters! Expedition Idle will be available on PC via Steam on July 30, 2026.
title: Expedition Idle - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Early Access Announcement Trailer for Don't Lose Aggro, an upcoming action party-based dungeon crawling game developed by Oren Koren. Players will make unique builds to take into battle from raid to raid. Don't Lose Aggro is coming soon to Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Don't Lose Aggro - Official Early Access Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Bathysphere, an exploration-based psychological horror game developed by Base0. Players will be taken to the 1940s in the middle of a bathysphere, trapped in an endless cycle of killing. Make use of the environment to break the time loop and seek the truth. Bathysphere is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Bathysphere - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Quarantine Zombies: Prologue trailer and get ready to experience the first four days of the Prologue, where FPS action meets quarantine inspection in post-apocalyptic Chicago. You’ve got 30 days until the army arrives. Hold out, fix your car, and fight your way to the main checkpoint to save your younger brother. The Quarantine Zombies: Prologue will be available in April 2026.
title: Quarantine Zombies: Prologue - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the NVIDIA DLSS 5 announcement trailer. The trailer's official description states: "NVIDIA DLSS 5, an AI-powered breakthrough in visual fidelity for games is coming later this year. DLSS 5 infuses pixels with photorealistic lighting and materials, bridging the gap between rendering and reality."

Source: https://www.youtube.com/@NVIDIAGeForce/videos

#NVIDIA #DLSS5 #Gaming
title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for HoverGrease 2, a sci-fi top-down hero shooter developed by Altergaze. Players will duke it out in intense matches across a bio-cyberpunk world. Make use of powerful classes, unique abilities, and play a suite of modes from a 14-chapter story mode or 5v5 multiplayer matches. HoverGrease 2 is launching on May 22 for HoverGrease 2 on PC (Steam).
title: HoverGrease 2 - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The New Game+ mode for Total Chaos is available now on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and Game Pass. Check out the latest Total Chaos trailer for this psychological horror game to see what to expect with the New Game+ mode, which features expanded story content, an alternate ending, new death animations, and unexplored locations. Total Chaos is available now on Windows PC via Steam (and is coming soon to GOG and the Epic Games Store), Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5. SteamVR support for Total Chaos on PC will arrive in Q2 2026.
title: Total Chaos - Official New Game+ Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Beyond the Hive Launch Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, a team-based co-op action first-person shooter developed by Fatshark. Players will soon be able to access a new update for the game, packed with the new Expeditions game mode, earnable cosmetics, new firepower, and more. The Beyond the Hive Update for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is launching on March 17 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam and Windows Store).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Official Beyond the Hive Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: New free content is coming to Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds. Check out the latest Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds trailer to see what to expect, as Red and Goro Majima (Captain Majima) are coming in April 2026, and Arle arrives in May 2026. Additionally, Sega Racing & Variety music tracks are also coming to the racing game. Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Official New Free Characters Update #2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!, a first-person action boomer shooter developed by Auroch Digital. Players will take on a variety of powerful bugs on hostile planets in the Starship Troopers universe. Do your part and fight for the Federation in Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell gets a new trailer showcasing action-packed gameplay and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell trailer for this upcoming FPS game. Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell will be available on PC on April 3, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

In Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell, demons are not the danger, you are the danger! Play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place.
title: Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the C4SH Gameplay Overview Trailer for Borderlands 4, the hit first-person action looter shooter developed by Gearbox. Players will be able to access the new Vault Hunter with C4SH joining the roster to make use of his gunslinging abilities with spell-slinging cards, dual-wielded revolvers, and more to keep the pressure on the opposition. Get an extended look at gameplay for C4SH in Borderlands 4, launching on March 26 as part of the Story Pack 1 DLC for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Borderlands 4 - Official C4SH Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the New Release Date Trailer for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by TT Games. Players will relive the multiple iconic eras of the Dark Knight across comics, animation, and movies to celebrate all things Batman. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is launching on May 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Official New Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Soul Maze, a multiplayer co-op asymmetric social game developed by KaliMoon Studio. Players will explore a procedurally generated maze to take on puzzles, overcome platforming challenges, and collect soul fragments before time runs out. Work together or betray the team in Soul Maze, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Soul Maze - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for DEADLINE DELIVERY, an arcade high-speed delivery game developed by GOOD1 Studios. Players will assume the role of Carl, a lowly monkey just trying to make ends meet and deliver packages as fast as possible. Zoom through the city on a time limit and ensure parcels are delivered before the explosives go off when the clock hits 0. DEADLINE DELIVERY is available now for PC (Steam).
title: DEADLINE DELIVERY - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Into the Crypt, a 3D roguelike deckbuilding card battler developed by Megaglope Studios. Players will battle deeper into the crypt to brave monstrosities from run to run. Acquire key upgrades, locate rare relics, and survive whatever the crypt throws your way. Into the Crypt is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Into the Crypt - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Rockett Gear EX, an upcoming 2D retro action platformer developed by Tumico Studio. Players will take on the threats of Project Z as Jett and Yuromi with Earth's fate in their capable hands. Fight through a sci-fi world packed with enemies to dispatch, platforming challenges to overcome, and powerful enhancements to acquire through progression. Rockett Gear EX is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Kickstarter available now to support the game's development.

Support the Kickstarter here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rockettgearex/rockett-gear-ex?ref=nav_search&result=project&term=rockett&total_hits=108
title: Rockett Gear EX - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Mirealle, a wholesome puzzle adventure game developed by qovagames. Players will progress through the ruins of a forgotten world after it's splintered into thousands of islands. Experience small-scale stories, solve puzzles, and explore vibrant locales. Mirelalle is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Mirealle - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Performance Capture Trailer for Death Stranding 2: On The Beach, the hit third-person action-adventure strand game developed by Kojima Productions. 

Players will take a look behind-the-scenes at the motion capture performance that brought the characters and world of Death Stranding 2: On The Beach to life on the adventure through Australia. Death Stranding 2: On The Beach is launching on March 19 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#DeathStranding2 #Adventure
title: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach - Official Performance Capture Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the Amargasaurus in this latest Jurassic World Evolution 3 trailer for the management sim game. 

Weighing in at around 2.9 tonnes and spanning 9.5m in length, the long-necked Amargasaurus family unit is available now in Jurassic World Evolution 3 as part of Update 1.2.6.

#IGN #JurassicWorldEvolution3 #JurassicPark
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 - Official Amargasaurus Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for ReVamp, a tower-defense strategy roguelike developed by Digital Sun. 

Players will fortify their defenses in the castle against mere mortals looking to take the throne. Play as Dracula to expand the castle, attain upgrades to tip the scales of battle, and turn the labyrinth into a weapon. ReVamp is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#ReVamp #TowerDefense
title: ReVamp - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out 3 minutes of combat gameplay from Falling Frontier in this video for the upcoming sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. In Falling Frontier, conquer a vast procedurally generated star system. 

Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae. Falling Frontier will be available on PC.

#FallingFrontiers #RTS
title: Falling Frontier - Official Combat Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Mobile Announcement Trailer for Gothic Classic, a renowned classic action RPG developed by Piranha Bytes. 

Players will return to the Kingdom of Myrtana after orcs invade the lands to make use of powerful weapons to take out adversaries across an expansive journey. 

Take the adventure on the go with Gothic Classic, coming soon to iOS, with the game being available now on Nintendo Switch.

#GothicClassic #MobileGaming
title: Gothic Classic - Official Mobile Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Vehicle Customization trailer for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite, the popular firefighting simulation game developed by Weltenbauer. 

Players are now able to freely customize their Firetruck, with a plethora of options ranging from colors, lightbar patterns and sirens. 

Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is out now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Official Vehicle Customization Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the launch trailer for Dragonkin: The Banished, an action hack-and-slash adventure RPG developed by Eko Software. Aid humanity in the fight from extinction as dragons roam and rule over the world. Journey to slay the Dragon Lords using powerful abilities, varied gear, and a variety of deadly weapons across four different classes. 

Dragonkin: The Banished, is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam)
title: Dragonkin: The Banished - Official Launch Trailer
